   212→// handleSessionInitErrors handles session initialization errors and provides user-friendly messages.
   213→func handleSessionInitErrors(ag agent.Agent, initErr error) error {
   214→	// Check for shadow branch conflict error (worktree conflict)
   215→	var conflictErr *strategy.ShadowBranchConflictError
   216→	if errors.As(initErr, &conflictErr) {
   217→		message := fmt.Sprintf(
   218→			"Warning: Shadow branch conflict detected!\n\n"+
   219→				"Branch: %s\n"+
   220→				"Existing session: %s\n"+
   221→				"From worktree: %s\n"+
   222→				"Started: %s\n\n"+
   223→				"This may indicate another agent session is active from a different worktree,\n"+
   224→				"or a previous session wasn't completed.\n\n"+
   225→				"Options:\n"+
   226→				"1. Commit your changes (git commit) to create a new base commit\n"+
   227→				"2. Run 'entire rewind reset' to discard the shadow branch and start fresh\n"+
   228→				"3. Continue the previous session from the original worktree: %s",
   229→			conflictErr.Branch,
   230→			conflictErr.ExistingSession,
   231→			conflictErr.ExistingWorktree,
   232→			conflictErr.LastActivity.Format(time.RFC822),
   233→			conflictErr.ExistingWorktree,
   234→		)
   235→		// Output blocking JSON response - user must resolve conflict before continuing
   236→		if err := outputHookResponse(false, message); err != nil {
   237→			return err
   238→		}
   239→		// Return nil so hook exits cleanly (status 0), not with error status
   240→		return nil
   241→	}
   242→
   243→	// Check for session ID conflict error (shadow branch has different session)
   244→	var sessionConflictErr *strategy.SessionIDConflictError
   245→	if errors.As(initErr, &sessionConflictErr) {
   246→		// If multi-session warnings are disabled, skip this error silently
   247→		// The user has explicitly opted to work with multiple concurrent sessions
   248→		if IsMultiSessionWarningDisabled() {
   249→			return nil
   250→		}
   251→
   252→		// Check if EITHER session has the concurrent warning shown
   253→		// If so, the user was already warned and chose to continue - allow concurrent sessions
   254→		existingState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionConflictErr.ExistingSession)
   255→		newState, newLoadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionConflictErr.NewSession)
   256→		if (loadErr == nil && existingState != nil && existingState.ConcurrentWarningShown) ||
   257→			(newLoadErr == nil && newState != nil && newState.ConcurrentWarningShown) {
   258→			// At least one session was warned - allow concurrent operation
   259→			return nil
   260→		}
   261→		// Try to get the conflicting session's agent type from its state file
   262→		// If it's a different agent type, use that agent's resume command format
   263→		var resumeCmd string
   264→		if loadErr == nil && existingState != nil && existingState.AgentType != "" {
   265→			if conflictingAgent, agentErr := agent.GetByAgentType(existingState.AgentType); agentErr == nil {
   266→				resumeCmd = conflictingAgent.FormatResumeCommand(conflictingAgent.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionConflictErr.ExistingSession))
   267→			}
   268→		}
   269→		// Fall back to current agent if we couldn't get the conflicting agent
   270→		if resumeCmd == "" {
   271→			resumeCmd = ag.FormatResumeCommand(ag.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionConflictErr.ExistingSession))
   272→		}
   273→		message := fmt.Sprintf(
   274→			"Warning: Session ID conflict detected!\n\n"+
   275→				"Shadow branch: %s\n"+
   276→				"Existing session: %s\n"+
   277→				"New session: %s\n\n"+
   278→				"The shadow branch already has checkpoints from a different session.\n"+
   279→				"Starting a new session would orphan the existing work.\n\n"+
   280→				"Options:\n"+
   281→				"1. Commit your changes (git commit) to create a new base commit\n"+
   282→				"2. Run 'entire rewind reset' to discard the shadow branch and start fresh\n"+
   283→				"3. Resume the existing session: %s\n\n"+
   284→				"To suppress this warning in future sessions, run:\n"+
   285→				"  entire enable --disable-multisession-warning",
   286→			sessionConflictErr.ShadowBranch,
   287→			sessionConflictErr.ExistingSession,
   288→			sessionConflictErr.NewSession,
   289→			resumeCmd,
   290→		)
   291→		// Output blocking JSON response - user must resolve conflict before continuing
   292→		if err := outputHookResponse(false, message); err != nil {
   293→			return err
   294→		}
   295→		// Return nil so hook exits cleanly (status 0), not with error status
   296→		return nil
   297→	}
   298→
   299→	// Unknown error type
   300→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to initialize session state: %v\n", initErr)
   301→	return nil
   302→}

   304→// captureInitialState captures the initial state on user prompt submit.
   305→func captureInitialState() error {
   306→	// Parse hook input and setup logging
   307→	hookData, err := parseAndLogHookInput()
   308→	if err != nil {
   309→		return err
   310→	}
   311→
   312→	// UNLESS the situation has changed (e.g., user committed, so no more conflict).
   313→	skipHook, err := checkConcurrentSessions(hookData.agent, hookData.entireSessionID)
   314→	if err != nil {
   315→		return err
   316→	}
   317→	if skipHook {
   318→		return nil
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	// CLI captures state directly (including transcript position)
   322→	if err := CapturePrePromptState(hookData.entireSessionID, hookData.input.SessionRef); err != nil {
   323→		return err
   324→	}
   325→
   326→	// If strategy implements SessionInitializer, call it to initialize session state
   327→	strat := GetStrategy()
   328→	if initializer, ok := strat.(strategy.SessionInitializer); ok {
   329→		agentType := hookData.agent.Type()
   330→		if initErr := initializer.InitializeSession(hookData.entireSessionID, agentType, hookData.input.SessionRef); initErr != nil {
   331→			if err := handleSessionInitErrors(hookData.agent, initErr); err != nil {
   332→				return err
   333→			}
   334→		}
   335→	}
   336→
   337→	return nil
   338→}

   340→// commitWithMetadata commits the session changes with metadata.
   341→func commitWithMetadata() error {
   342→	// Skip on default branch for strategies that don't allow it
   343→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranchForStrategy(); skip {
   344→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping on branch '%s' - create a feature branch to use Entire tracking\n", branchName)
   345→		return nil // Don't fail the hook, just skip
   346→	}
   347→
   348→	// Get the agent for hook input parsing and session ID transformation
   349→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   350→	if err != nil {
   351→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   352→	}
   353→
   354→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
   355→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookStop, os.Stdin)
   356→	if err != nil {
   357→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   358→	}
   359→
   360→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   361→	logging.Info(logCtx, "stop",
   362→		slog.String("hook", "stop"),
   363→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   364→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   365→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
   366→	)
   367→
   368→	modelSessionID := input.SessionID
   369→	if modelSessionID == "" {
   370→		modelSessionID = unknownSessionID
   371→	}
   372→
   373→	// Get the Entire session ID, preferring the persisted value to handle midnight boundary
   374→	entireSessionID := currentSessionIDWithFallback(modelSessionID)
   375→
   376→	transcriptPath := input.SessionRef
   377→	if transcriptPath == "" || !fileExists(transcriptPath) {
   378→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found or empty: %s", transcriptPath)
   379→	}
   380→
   381→	// Create session metadata folder using the entire session ID (preserves original date on resume)
   382→	// Use AbsPath to ensure we create at repo root, not relative to cwd
   383→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromEntireID(entireSessionID)
   384→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(sessionDir)
   385→	if err != nil {
   386→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir // Fallback to relative
   387→	}
   388→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   389→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   390→	}
   391→
   392→	// Copy transcript
   393→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   394→	if err := copyFile(transcriptPath, logFile); err != nil {
   395→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   396→	}
   397→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copied transcript to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName)
   398→
   399→	// Load session state to get transcript offset (for strategies that track it)
   400→	// This is used to only parse NEW transcript lines since the last checkpoint
   401→	var transcriptOffset int
   402→	sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(entireSessionID)
   403→	if loadErr != nil {
   404→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   405→	}
   406→	if sessionState != nil {
   407→		transcriptOffset = sessionState.CondensedTranscriptLines
   408→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   409→	}
   410→
   411→	// Parse transcript (optionally from offset for strategies that track transcript position)
   412→	// When transcriptOffset > 0, only parse NEW lines since the last checkpoint
   413→	var transcript []transcriptLine
   414→	var totalLines int
   415→	if transcriptOffset > 0 {
   416→		// Parse only NEW lines since last checkpoint
   417→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset)
   418→		if err != nil {
   419→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript from line %d: %w", transcriptOffset, err)
   420→		}
   421→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Parsed %d new transcript lines (total: %d)\n", len(transcript), totalLines)
   422→	} else {
   423→		// First prompt or no session state - parse entire transcript
   424→		// Use parseTranscriptFromLine with offset 0 to also get totalLines
   425→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   426→		if err != nil {
   427→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   428→		}
   429→	}
   430→
   431→	// Extract all prompts since last checkpoint for prompt file
   432→	allPrompts := extractUserPrompts(transcript)
   433→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   434→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   435→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   436→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   437→	}
   438→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted %d prompt(s) to: %s\n", len(allPrompts), sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName)
   439→
   440→	// Extract summary
   441→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   442→	summary := extractLastAssistantMessage(transcript)
   443→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   444→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   445→	}
   446→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted summary to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName)
   447→
   448→	// Get modified files from transcript
   449→	modifiedFiles := extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   450→
   451→	// Generate commit message from last user prompt
   452→	lastPrompt := ""
   453→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   454→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   455→	}
   456→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt)
   457→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Using commit message: %s\n", commitMessage)
   458→
   459→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   460→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   461→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   462→	if err != nil {
   463→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   464→	}
   465→
   466→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on UserPromptSubmit)
   467→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(entireSessionID)
   468→	if err != nil {
   469→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   470→	}
   471→	if preState != nil {
   472→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Loaded pre-prompt state: %d pre-existing untracked files\n", len(preState.UntrackedFiles))
   473→	}
   474→
   475→	// Compute new files (files created during session)
   476→	newFiles, err := ComputeNewFiles(preState)
   477→	if err != nil {
   478→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute new files: %v\n", err)
   479→	}
   480→
   481→	// Compute deleted files (tracked files that were deleted)
   482→	deletedFiles, err := ComputeDeletedFiles()
   483→	if err != nil {
   484→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute deleted files: %v\n", err)
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	// Filter and normalize all paths (CLI responsibility)
   488→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   489→	relNewFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(newFiles, repoRoot)
   490→	relDeletedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(deletedFiles, repoRoot)
   491→
   492→	// Check if there are any changes to commit
   493→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   494→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   495→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No files were modified during this session\n")
   496→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Skipping commit\n")
   497→		// Clean up state even when skipping
   498→		if err := CleanupPrePromptState(entireSessionID); err != nil {
   499→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   500→		}
   501→		return nil
   502→	}
   503→
   504→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   505→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   506→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   507→	}
   508→	if len(relNewFiles) > 0 {
   509→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "New files created (%d):\n", len(relNewFiles))
   510→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {
   511→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  + %s\n", file)
   512→		}
   513→	}
   514→	if len(relDeletedFiles) > 0 {
   515→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files deleted (%d):\n", len(relDeletedFiles))
   516→		for _, file := range relDeletedFiles {
   517→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   518→		}
   519→	}
   520→
   521→	// Create context file before saving changes
   522→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   523→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, entireSessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcript); err != nil {
   524→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   525→	}
   526→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Created context file: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.ContextFileName)
   527→
   528→	// Get git author from local/global config
   529→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   530→	if err != nil {
   531→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   532→	}
   533→
   534→	// Get the configured strategy
   535→	strat := GetStrategy()
   536→
   537→	// Ensure strategy setup is in place (auto-installs git hook, gitignore, etc. if needed)
   538→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   539→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   540→	}
   541→
   542→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   543→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   544→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   545→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   546→	}
   547→
   548→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at checkpoint start)
   549→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   550→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   551→	if preState != nil {
   552→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   553→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptLineCount
   554→	}
   555→
   556→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific)
   557→	var tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
   558→	if transcriptPath != "" {
   559→		// Subagents are stored in a subagents/ directory next to the main transcript
   560→		subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), entireSessionID, "subagents")
   561→		usage, err := claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   562→		if err != nil {
   563→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to calculate token usage: %v\n", err)
   564→		} else {
   565→			tokenUsage = usage
   566→		}
   567→	}
   568→
   569→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   570→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{
   571→		SessionID:                   entireSessionID,
   572→		ModifiedFiles:               relModifiedFiles,
   573→		NewFiles:                    relNewFiles,
   574→		DeletedFiles:                relDeletedFiles,
   575→		MetadataDir:                 sessionDir,
   576→		MetadataDirAbs:              sessionDirAbs,
   577→		CommitMessage:               commitMessage,
   578→		TranscriptPath:              transcriptPath,
   579→		AuthorName:                  author.Name,
   580→		AuthorEmail:                 author.Email,
   581→		AgentType:                   agentType,
   582→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   583→		TranscriptLinesAtStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   584→		TokenUsage:                  tokenUsage,
   585→	}
   586→
   587→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   588→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   589→	}
   590→
   591→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   592→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   593→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   594→	// Note: Shadow strategy doesn't create commits on the active branch, so its
   595→	// checkpoints don't "consume" the transcript in the same way. Shadow should
   596→	// continue parsing the full transcript to capture all files touched in the session.
   597→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   598→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   599→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   600→		if sessionState == nil {
   601→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   602→				SessionID: entireSessionID,
   603→			}
   604→		}
   605→		sessionState.CondensedTranscriptLines = totalLines
   606→		sessionState.CheckpointCount++
   607→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   608→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   609→		} else {
   610→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   611→				totalLines, sessionState.CheckpointCount)
   612→		}
   613→	}
   614→
   615→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   616→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(entireSessionID); err != nil {
   617→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   618→	}
   619→
   620→	return nil
   621→}

   623→// handlePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   624→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   625→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   626→func handlePostTodo() error {
   627→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   628→	if err != nil {
   629→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   630→	}
   631→
   632→	// Get agent for logging context
   633→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   634→	if err != nil {
   635→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   636→	}
   637→
   638→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   639→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   640→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   641→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   642→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   643→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   644→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   645→	)
   646→
   647→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   648→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   649→	if !found {
   650→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   651→		return nil
   652→	}
   653→
   654→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   655→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   656→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   657→		return nil
   658→	}
   659→
   660→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   661→	modified, newFiles, deleted, err := DetectChangedFiles()
   662→	if err != nil {
   663→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   664→		return nil
   665→	}
   666→
   667→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   668→	if len(modified) == 0 && len(newFiles) == 0 && len(deleted) == 0 {
   669→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   670→		return nil
   671→	}
   672→
   673→	// Get git author
   674→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   675→	if err != nil {
   676→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   677→		return nil
   678→	}
   679→
   680→	// Get the active strategy
   681→	strat := GetStrategy()
   682→
   683→	// Ensure strategy setup is complete
   684→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   685→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   686→		return nil
   687→	}
   688→
   689→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   690→	sessionID := paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   691→	if sessionID == "" {
   692→		sessionID = input.SessionID
   693→	}
   694→	entireSessionID := currentSessionIDWithFallback(sessionID)
   695→
   696→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   697→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(entireSessionID, taskToolUseID)
   698→
   699→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   700→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   701→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   702→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   703→	if todoContent == "" {
   704→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   705→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   706→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   707→		if todoCount > 0 {
   708→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   709→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   710→		}
   711→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   712→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   713→	}
   714→
   715→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   716→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   717→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   718→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   719→	}
   720→
   721→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   722→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   723→		SessionID:           entireSessionID,
   724→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   725→		ModifiedFiles:       modified,
   726→		NewFiles:            newFiles,
   727→		DeletedFiles:        deleted,
   728→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   729→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   730→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   731→		IsIncremental:       true,
   732→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   733→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   734→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   735→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   736→		AgentType:           agentType,
   737→	}
   738→
   739→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   740→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   741→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   742→		return nil
   743→	}
   744→
   745→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   746→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   747→	return nil
   748→}

   792→// handlePostTask handles the PostToolUse[Task] hook
   793→func handlePostTask() error {
   794→	// Skip on default branch for strategies that don't allow it
   795→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranchForStrategy(); skip {
   796→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping on branch '%s' - create a feature branch to use Entire tracking\n", branchName)
   797→		return nil // Don't fail the hook, just skip
   798→	}
   799→
   800→	input, err := parsePostTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   801→	if err != nil {
   802→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   803→	}
   804→
   805→	// Extract subagent type from tool_input for logging
   806→	subagentType, taskDescription := ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(input.ToolInput)
   807→
   808→	// Get agent for logging context
   809→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   810→	if err != nil {
   811→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   812→	}
   813→
   814→	// Log parsed input context
   815→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   816→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-task",
   817→		slog.String("hook", "post-task"),
   818→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   819→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   820→		slog.String("agent_id", input.AgentID),
   821→		slog.String("subagent_type", subagentType),
   822→	)
   823→
   824→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   825→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(input.TranscriptPath)
   826→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   827→	if input.AgentID != "" {
   828→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, input.AgentID)
   829→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   830→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   831→		}
   832→	}
   833→
   834→	// Log context to stdout
   835→	logPostTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input, subagentTranscriptPath)
   836→

     4→// Sessions can be nested - when a subagent runs, it creates a sub-session within
     5→// the parent session.

     8→//
     9→//  1. Sessions interface - High-level CRUD operations for full session objects,
    10→//     combining session state with checkpoint data. This is the primary interface
    11→//     for commands and the UI layer.
    12→//
    13→//  2. StateStore - Low-level primitive for managing session state files in
    14→//     .git/entire-sessions/. This tracks active session state (base commit,
    15→//     checkpoint count, etc.) but doesn't handle checkpoint content. Strategies
    16→//     use this directly for performance-critical state management.

    19→package session

    22→	"context"

    30→// Sessions can be nested when subagents are used.

    32→	// ID is the unique session identifier
    33→	ID string
    34→
    35→	// FirstPrompt is the raw first user prompt (immutable)
    36→	FirstPrompt string
    37→
    38→	// Description is a human-readable summary (derived or editable)

    44→	// AgentType identifies the AI agent (e.g., "Claude Code", "Cursor")
    45→	AgentType agent.AgentType
    46→
    47→	// AgentSessionID is the agent's internal session identifier
    48→	AgentSessionID string
    49→
    50→	// Checkpoints contains save points within this session
    51→	Checkpoints []checkpoint.Checkpoint
    52→
    53→	// SubSessions contains nested sessions from subagent work
    54→	SubSessions []Session

   345→// race on file cleanup. In practice this is not an issue since agent hooks are
   346→// called sequentially within a session.
   347→func GetOrCreateEntireSessionID(agentSessionID string) string {

   351→			slog.String("input", agentSessionID),
   352→			slog.Any("error", err))

   354→		// Don't generate random ID as that breaks session continuity
   355→		return sessionid.EntireSessionID(agentSessionID)

   358→	commonDir, err := getGitCommonDir()
   359→	if err != nil {
   360→		// Can't get common dir (corrupt git repo?) - fall back to new ID
   361→		return sessionid.EntireSessionID(agentSessionID)

   368→		return sessionid.EntireSessionID(agentSessionID)
   369→	}
   370→
   371→	// Collect all matching session IDs
   372→	var matches []string
   373→	for _, entry := range entries {
   374→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   375→			continue
   376→		}
   377→
   378→		existingSessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")

   381→		if existingUUID == agentSessionID {
   382→			matches = append(matches, existingSessionID)
   383→		}
   384→	}

   387→		// No existing session found - create new ID with today's date
   388→		return sessionid.EntireSessionID(agentSessionID)
   389→	}

   391→	// Pick most recent (YYYY-MM-DD sorts correctly lexicographically)
   392→	sort.Strings(matches)
   393→	mostRecent := matches[len(matches)-1]

   396→	for _, oldID := range matches[:len(matches)-1] {
   397→		oldFile := filepath.Join(stateDir, oldID+".json")
   398→		_ = os.Remove(oldFile)
   399→	}
   400→
   401→	return mostRecent

    38→		} else if modelSessionID == "" || sessionid.ModelSessionID(entireSessionID) == modelSessionID {
    39→			return entireSessionID
    40→		} else {
    41→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: persisted session ID does not match hook session ID\n")
    42→		}
    43→	}
    44→	if modelSessionID == "" {
    45→		return ""
    46→	}
    47→	// Get or create stable session ID (reuses existing if session resumed across days)
    48→	return session.GetOrCreateEntireSessionID(modelSessionID)
    49→}

    97→// checkConcurrentSessions checks for concurrent session conflicts and shows warnings if needed.
    98→// Returns true if the hook should be skipped due to an unresolved conflict.
    99→func checkConcurrentSessions(ag agent.Agent, entireSessionID string) (bool, error) {
   100→	// Check if warnings are disabled via settings
   101→	if IsMultiSessionWarningDisabled() {
   102→		return false, nil
   103→	}
   104→
   105→	strat := GetStrategy()
   106→
   107→	concurrentChecker, ok := strat.(strategy.ConcurrentSessionChecker)
   108→	if !ok {
   109→		return false, nil // Strategy doesn't support concurrent checks
   110→	}
   111→
   112→	// Check if this session already acknowledged the warning
   113→	existingState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(entireSessionID)
   114→	warningAlreadyShown := loadErr == nil && existingState != nil && existingState.ConcurrentWarningShown
   115→
   116→	// Check for other active sessions with checkpoints (on current HEAD)
   117→	otherSession, checkErr := concurrentChecker.HasOtherActiveSessionsWithCheckpoints(entireSessionID)
   118→	hasConflict := checkErr == nil && otherSession != nil
   119→
   120→	if warningAlreadyShown {
   121→		if hasConflict {
   122→			// Warning was shown and conflict still exists - skip hooks
   123→			return true, nil
   124→		}
   125→		// Warning was shown but conflict is resolved (e.g., user committed)
   126→		// Clear the flag and proceed normally
   127→		if existingState != nil {
   128→			existingState.ConcurrentWarningShown = false
   129→			if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(existingState); saveErr != nil {
   130→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to clear concurrent warning flag: %v\n", saveErr)
   131→			}
   132→		}
   133→		return false, nil
   134→	}
   135→
   136→	if hasConflict {
   137→		// First time seeing conflict - show warning
   138→		// Include BaseCommit and WorktreePath so session state is complete for condensation
   139→		repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository()
   140→		if err != nil {
   141→			// Output user-friendly error message via hook response
   142→			if outputErr := outputHookResponse(false, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to open git repository: %v\n\nPlease ensure you're in a git repository and try again.", err)); outputErr != nil {
   143→				return false, outputErr
   144→			}
   145→			return true, nil // Skip hook after outputting response
   146→		}
   147→		head, err := repo.Head()
   148→		if err != nil {
   149→			// Output user-friendly error message via hook response
   150→			if outputErr := outputHookResponse(false, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to get git HEAD: %v\n\nPlease ensure the repository has at least one commit.", err)); outputErr != nil {
   151→				return false, outputErr
   152→			}
   153→			return true, nil // Skip hook after outputting response
   154→		}
   155→		worktreePath, err := strategy.GetWorktreePath()
   156→		if err != nil {
   157→			// Non-fatal: continue without worktree path
   158→			worktreePath = ""
   159→		}
   160→		agentType := ag.Type()
   161→		newState := &strategy.SessionState{
   162→			SessionID:              entireSessionID,
   163→			BaseCommit:             head.Hash().String(),
   164→			WorktreePath:           worktreePath,
   165→			ConcurrentWarningShown: true,
   166→			StartedAt:              time.Now(),
   167→			AgentType:              agentType,
   168→		}
   169→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(newState); saveErr != nil {
   170→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save session state: %v\n", saveErr)
   171→		}
   172→
   173→		// Get resume command for the other session using the CONFLICTING session's agent type.
   174→		// If the conflicting session is from a different agent (e.g., Gemini when we're Claude),
   175→		// use that agent's resume command format. Otherwise, use our own format (backward compatible).
   176→		var resumeCmd string
   177→		if otherSession.AgentType != "" && otherSession.AgentType != agentType {
   178→			// Different agent type - look up the conflicting agent
   179→			if conflictingAgent, agentErr := agent.GetByAgentType(otherSession.AgentType); agentErr == nil {
   180→				resumeCmd = conflictingAgent.FormatResumeCommand(conflictingAgent.ExtractAgentSessionID(otherSession.SessionID))
   181→			}
   182→		}
   183→		// Fall back to current agent if same type or couldn't get the conflicting agent
   184→		if resumeCmd == "" {
   185→			resumeCmd = ag.FormatResumeCommand(ag.ExtractAgentSessionID(otherSession.SessionID))
   186→		}
   187→
   188→		// Try to read the other session's initial prompt
   189→		otherPrompt := strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromShadow(repo, otherSession.BaseCommit, otherSession.SessionID)
   190→
   191→		// Build message with other session's prompt if available
   192→		var message string
   193→		suppressHint := "\n\nTo suppress this warning in future sessions, run:\n  entire enable --disable-multisession-warning"
   194→		if otherPrompt != "" {
   195→			message = fmt.Sprintf("Another session is active: \"%s\"\n\nYou can continue here, but checkpoints from both sessions will be interleaved.\n\nTo resume the other session instead, exit Claude and run: %s%s\n\nPress the up arrow key to get your prompt back.", otherPrompt, resumeCmd, suppressHint)
   196→		} else {
   197→			message = "Another session is active with uncommitted changes. You can continue here, but checkpoints from both sessions will be interleaved.\n\nTo resume the other session instead, exit Claude and run: " + resumeCmd + suppressHint + "\n\nPress the up arrow key to get your prompt back."
   198→		}
   199→
   200→		// Output blocking JSON response - warn about concurrent sessions but allow continuation
   201→		// Both sessions will capture checkpoints, which will be interleaved on the shadow branch
   202→		if err := outputHookResponse(false, message); err != nil {
   203→			return false, err // Failed to output response
   204→		}
   205→		// Block the first prompt to show the warning, but subsequent prompts will proceed
   206→		return true, nil
   207→	}
   208→
   209→	return false, nil
   210→}

   212→// handleSessionInitErrors handles session initialization errors and provides user-friendly messages.
   213→func handleSessionInitErrors(ag agent.Agent, initErr error) error {
   214→	// Check for shadow branch conflict error (worktree conflict)
   215→	var conflictErr *strategy.ShadowBranchConflictError
   216→	if errors.As(initErr, &conflictErr) {
   217→		message := fmt.Sprintf(
   218→			"Warning: Shadow branch conflict detected!\n\n"+
   219→				"Branch: %s\n"+
   220→				"Existing session: %s\n"+
   221→				"From worktree: %s\n"+
   222→				"Started: %s\n\n"+
   223→				"This may indicate another agent session is active from a different worktree,\n"+
   224→				"or a previous session wasn't completed.\n\n"+
   225→				"Options:\n"+
   226→				"1. Commit your changes (git commit) to create a new base commit\n"+
   227→				"2. Run 'entire rewind reset' to discard the shadow branch and start fresh\n"+
   228→				"3. Continue the previous session from the original worktree: %s",
   229→			conflictErr.Branch,
   230→			conflictErr.ExistingSession,
   231→			conflictErr.ExistingWorktree,
   232→			conflictErr.LastActivity.Format(time.RFC822),
   233→			conflictErr.ExistingWorktree,
   234→		)
   235→		// Output blocking JSON response - user must resolve conflict before continuing
   236→		if err := outputHookResponse(false, message); err != nil {
   237→			return err
   238→		}
   239→		// Return nil so hook exits cleanly (status 0), not with error status
   240→		return nil
   241→	}
   242→
   243→	// Check for session ID conflict error (shadow branch has different session)
   244→	var sessionConflictErr *strategy.SessionIDConflictError
   245→	if errors.As(initErr, &sessionConflictErr) {
   246→		// If multi-session warnings are disabled, skip this error silently
   247→		// The user has explicitly opted to work with multiple concurrent sessions
   248→		if IsMultiSessionWarningDisabled() {
   249→			return nil
   250→		}
   251→
   252→		// Check if EITHER session has the concurrent warning shown
   253→		// If so, the user was already warned and chose to continue - allow concurrent sessions
   254→		existingState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionConflictErr.ExistingSession)
   255→		newState, newLoadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionConflictErr.NewSession)
   256→		if (loadErr == nil && existingState != nil && existingState.ConcurrentWarningShown) ||
   257→			(newLoadErr == nil && newState != nil && newState.ConcurrentWarningShown) {
   258→			// At least one session was warned - allow concurrent operation
   259→			return nil
   260→		}
   261→		// Try to get the conflicting session's agent type from its state file
   262→		// If it's a different agent type, use that agent's resume command format
   263→		var resumeCmd string
   264→		if loadErr == nil && existingState != nil && existingState.AgentType != "" {
   265→			if conflictingAgent, agentErr := agent.GetByAgentType(existingState.AgentType); agentErr == nil {
   266→				resumeCmd = conflictingAgent.FormatResumeCommand(conflictingAgent.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionConflictErr.ExistingSession))
   267→			}
   268→		}
   269→		// Fall back to current agent if we couldn't get the conflicting agent
   270→		if resumeCmd == "" {
   271→			resumeCmd = ag.FormatResumeCommand(ag.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionConflictErr.ExistingSession))
   272→		}
   273→		message := fmt.Sprintf(
   274→			"Warning: Session ID conflict detected!\n\n"+
   275→				"Shadow branch: %s\n"+
   276→				"Existing session: %s\n"+
   277→				"New session: %s\n\n"+
   278→				"The shadow branch already has checkpoints from a different session.\n"+
   279→				"Starting a new session would orphan the existing work.\n\n"+
   280→				"Options:\n"+
   281→				"1. Commit your changes (git commit) to create a new base commit\n"+
   282→				"2. Run 'entire rewind reset' to discard the shadow branch and start fresh\n"+
   283→				"3. Resume the existing session: %s\n\n"+
   284→				"To suppress this warning in future sessions, run:\n"+
   285→				"  entire enable --disable-multisession-warning",
   286→			sessionConflictErr.ShadowBranch,
   287→			sessionConflictErr.ExistingSession,
   288→			sessionConflictErr.NewSession,
   289→			resumeCmd,
   290→		)
   291→		// Output blocking JSON response - user must resolve conflict before continuing
   292→		if err := outputHookResponse(false, message); err != nil {
   293→			return err
   294→		}
   295→		// Return nil so hook exits cleanly (status 0), not with error status
   296→		return nil
   297→	}
   298→
   299→	// Unknown error type
   300→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to initialize session state: %v\n", initErr)
   301→	return nil
   302→}

   304→// captureInitialState captures the initial state on user prompt submit.
   305→func captureInitialState() error {
   306→	// Parse hook input and setup logging
   307→	hookData, err := parseAndLogHookInput()
   308→	if err != nil {
   309→		return err
   310→	}
   311→
   312→	// UNLESS the situation has changed (e.g., user committed, so no more conflict).
   313→	skipHook, err := checkConcurrentSessions(hookData.agent, hookData.entireSessionID)
   314→	if err != nil {
   315→		return err
   316→	}
   317→	if skipHook {
   318→		return nil
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	// CLI captures state directly (including transcript position)
   322→	if err := CapturePrePromptState(hookData.entireSessionID, hookData.input.SessionRef); err != nil {
   323→		return err
   324→	}
   325→
   326→	// If strategy implements SessionInitializer, call it to initialize session state
   327→	strat := GetStrategy()
   328→	if initializer, ok := strat.(strategy.SessionInitializer); ok {
   329→		agentType := hookData.agent.Type()
   330→		if initErr := initializer.InitializeSession(hookData.entireSessionID, agentType, hookData.input.SessionRef); initErr != nil {
   331→			if err := handleSessionInitErrors(hookData.agent, initErr); err != nil {
   332→				return err
   333→			}
   334→		}
   335→	}
   336→
   337→	return nil
   338→}

   340→// commitWithMetadata commits the session changes with metadata.
   341→func commitWithMetadata() error {
   342→	// Skip on default branch for strategies that don't allow it
   343→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranchForStrategy(); skip {
   344→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping on branch '%s' - create a feature branch to use Entire tracking\n", branchName)
   345→		return nil // Don't fail the hook, just skip
   346→	}
   347→
   348→	// Get the agent for hook input parsing and session ID transformation
   349→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   350→	if err != nil {
   351→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   352→	}
   353→
   354→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
   355→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookStop, os.Stdin)
   356→	if err != nil {
   357→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   358→	}
   359→
   360→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   361→	logging.Info(logCtx, "stop",
   362→		slog.String("hook", "stop"),
   363→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   364→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   365→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
   366→	)
   367→
   368→	modelSessionID := input.SessionID
   369→	if modelSessionID == "" {
   370→		modelSessionID = unknownSessionID
   371→	}
   372→
   373→	// Get the Entire session ID, preferring the persisted value to handle midnight boundary
   374→	entireSessionID := currentSessionIDWithFallback(modelSessionID)
   375→
   376→	transcriptPath := input.SessionRef
   377→	if transcriptPath == "" || !fileExists(transcriptPath) {
   378→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found or empty: %s", transcriptPath)
   379→	}
   380→
   381→	// Create session metadata folder using the entire session ID (preserves original date on resume)
   382→	// Use AbsPath to ensure we create at repo root, not relative to cwd
   383→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromEntireID(entireSessionID)
   384→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(sessionDir)
   385→	if err != nil {
   386→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir // Fallback to relative
   387→	}
   388→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   389→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   390→	}
   391→
   392→	// Copy transcript
   393→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   394→	if err := copyFile(transcriptPath, logFile); err != nil {
   395→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   396→	}
   397→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copied transcript to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName)
   398→
   399→	// Load session state to get transcript offset (for strategies that track it)
   400→	// This is used to only parse NEW transcript lines since the last checkpoint
   401→	var transcriptOffset int
   402→	sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(entireSessionID)
   403→	if loadErr != nil {
   404→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   405→	}
   406→	if sessionState != nil {
   407→		transcriptOffset = sessionState.CondensedTranscriptLines
   408→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   409→	}
   410→
   411→	// Parse transcript (optionally from offset for strategies that track transcript position)
   412→	// When transcriptOffset > 0, only parse NEW lines since the last checkpoint
   413→	var transcript []transcriptLine
   414→	var totalLines int
   415→	if transcriptOffset > 0 {
   416→		// Parse only NEW lines since last checkpoint
   417→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset)
   418→		if err != nil {
   419→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript from line %d: %w", transcriptOffset, err)
   420→		}
   421→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Parsed %d new transcript lines (total: %d)\n", len(transcript), totalLines)
   422→	} else {
   423→		// First prompt or no session state - parse entire transcript
   424→		// Use parseTranscriptFromLine with offset 0 to also get totalLines
   425→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   426→		if err != nil {
   427→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   428→		}
   429→	}
   430→
   431→	// Extract all prompts since last checkpoint for prompt file
   432→	allPrompts := extractUserPrompts(transcript)
   433→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   434→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   435→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   436→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   437→	}
   438→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted %d prompt(s) to: %s\n", len(allPrompts), sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName)
   439→
   440→	// Extract summary
   441→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   442→	summary := extractLastAssistantMessage(transcript)
   443→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   444→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   445→	}
   446→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted summary to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName)
   447→
   448→	// Get modified files from transcript
   449→	modifiedFiles := extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   450→
   451→	// Generate commit message from last user prompt
   452→	lastPrompt := ""
   453→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   454→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   455→	}
   456→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt)
   457→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Using commit message: %s\n", commitMessage)
   458→
   459→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   460→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   461→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   462→	if err != nil {
   463→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   464→	}
   465→
   466→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on UserPromptSubmit)
   467→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(entireSessionID)
   468→	if err != nil {
   469→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   470→	}
   471→	if preState != nil {
   472→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Loaded pre-prompt state: %d pre-existing untracked files\n", len(preState.UntrackedFiles))
   473→	}
   474→
   475→	// Compute new files (files created during session)
   476→	newFiles, err := ComputeNewFiles(preState)
   477→	if err != nil {
   478→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute new files: %v\n", err)
   479→	}
   480→
   481→	// Compute deleted files (tracked files that were deleted)
   482→	deletedFiles, err := ComputeDeletedFiles()
   483→	if err != nil {
   484→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute deleted files: %v\n", err)
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	// Filter and normalize all paths (CLI responsibility)
   488→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   489→	relNewFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(newFiles, repoRoot)
   490→	relDeletedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(deletedFiles, repoRoot)
   491→
   492→	// Check if there are any changes to commit
   493→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   494→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   495→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No files were modified during this session\n")
   496→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Skipping commit\n")
   497→		// Clean up state even when skipping
   498→		if err := CleanupPrePromptState(entireSessionID); err != nil {
   499→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   500→		}
   501→		return nil
   502→	}
   503→
   504→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   505→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   506→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   507→	}
   508→	if len(relNewFiles) > 0 {
   509→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "New files created (%d):\n", len(relNewFiles))
   510→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {
   511→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  + %s\n", file)
   512→		}
   513→	}
   514→	if len(relDeletedFiles) > 0 {
   515→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files deleted (%d):\n", len(relDeletedFiles))
   516→		for _, file := range relDeletedFiles {
   517→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   518→		}
   519→	}
   520→
   521→	// Create context file before saving changes
   522→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   523→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, entireSessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcript); err != nil {
   524→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   525→	}
   526→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Created context file: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.ContextFileName)
   527→
   528→	// Get git author from local/global config
   529→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   530→	if err != nil {
   531→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   532→	}
   533→
   534→	// Get the configured strategy
   535→	strat := GetStrategy()
   536→

1→// Package session provides domain types and interfaces for managing AI coding sessions.
     2→//
     3→// A Session represents a unit of work with an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.).
     4→// Sessions can be nested - when a subagent runs, it creates a sub-session within
     5→// the parent session.
     6→//
     7→// This package provides two levels of abstraction:
     8→//
     9→//  1. Sessions interface - High-level CRUD operations for full session objects,
    10→//     combining session state with checkpoint data. This is the primary interface
    11→//     for commands and the UI layer.
    12→//
    13→//  2. StateStore - Low-level primitive for managing session state files in
    14→//     .git/entire-sessions/. This tracks active session state (base commit,
    15→//     checkpoint count, etc.) but doesn't handle checkpoint content. Strategies
    16→//     use this directly for performance-critical state management.
    17→//
    18→// See docs/architecture/sessions-and-checkpoints.md for the full domain model.
    19→package session
    20→
    21→import (
    22→	"context"
    23→	"time"
    24→
    25→	"entire.io/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent"
    26→	"entire.io/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint"
    27→)
    28→
    29→// Session represents a unit of work with an AI coding agent.
    30→// Sessions can be nested when subagents are used.
    31→type Session struct {
    32→	// ID is the unique session identifier
    33→	ID string
    34→
    35→	// FirstPrompt is the raw first user prompt (immutable)
    36→	FirstPrompt string
    37→
    38→	// Description is a human-readable summary (derived or editable)
    39→	Description string
    40→
    41→	// StartTime is when the session was started
    42→	StartTime time.Time
    43→
    44→	// AgentType identifies the AI agent (e.g., "Claude Code", "Cursor")
    45→	AgentType agent.AgentType
    46→
    47→	// AgentSessionID is the agent's internal session identifier
    48→	AgentSessionID string
    49→
    50→	// Checkpoints contains save points within this session
    51→	Checkpoints []checkpoint.Checkpoint
    52→
    53→	// SubSessions contains nested sessions from subagent work
    54→	SubSessions []Session
    55→
    56→	// ParentID is the parent session ID (empty for top-level sessions)
    57→	ParentID string
    58→
    59→	// ToolUseID is the tool invocation that spawned this sub-session
    60→	// (empty for top-level sessions)
    61→	ToolUseID string
    62→}
    63→
    64→// IsSubSession returns true if this session is a sub-session (has a parent).
    65→func (s *Session) IsSubSession() bool {
    66→	return s.ParentID != ""
    67→}
    68→
    69→// Sessions provides operations for managing sessions.
    70→type Sessions interface {
    71→	// Create creates a new session with the given options.
    72→	Create(ctx context.Context, opts CreateSessionOptions) (*Session, error)
    73→
    74→	// Get retrieves a session by ID.
    75→	Get(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*Session, error)
    76→
    77→	// List returns all top-level sessions (excludes sub-sessions).
    78→	List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error)
    79→}
    80→
    81→// CreateSessionOptions contains parameters for creating a new session.
    82→type CreateSessionOptions struct {
    83→	// FirstPrompt is the initial user prompt
    84→	FirstPrompt string
    85→
    86→	// AgentType identifies the AI agent (e.g., "Claude Code", "Cursor")
    87→	AgentType agent.AgentType

    93→	ParentID string
    94→
    95→	// ToolUseID is the tool invocation that spawned this sub-session

   111→//
   112→// StateStore is a primitive for session state persistence. It is NOT the same as
   113→// the Sessions interface - it only handles state files in .git/entire-sessions/,
   114→// not the full session data which includes checkpoint content.
   115→//
   116→// Use StateStore directly in strategies for performance-critical state operations.
   117→// Use the Sessions interface (when implemented) for high-level session management.
   118→type StateStore struct {
   119→	// stateDir is the directory where session state files are stored
   120→	stateDir string
   121→}
   122→
   123→// NewStateStore creates a new state store.
   124→// Uses the git common dir to store session state (shared across worktrees).
   125→func NewStateStore() (*StateStore, error) {
   126→	commonDir, err := getGitCommonDir()
   127→	if err != nil {
   128→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   129→	}
   130→	return &StateStore{
   131→		stateDir: filepath.Join(commonDir, sessionStateDirName),
   132→	}, nil
   133→}
   134→
   135→// NewStateStoreWithDir creates a new state store with a custom directory.
   136→// This is useful for testing.
   137→func NewStateStoreWithDir(stateDir string) *StateStore {
   138→	return &StateStore{stateDir: stateDir}
   139→}
   140→
   141→// Load loads the session state for the given session ID.
   142→// Returns (nil, nil) when session file doesn't exist (not an error condition).
   143→func (s *StateStore) Load(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*State, error) {
   144→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   145→
   146→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   147→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   148→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   152→
   153→	data, err := os.ReadFile(stateFile) //nolint:gosec // stateFile is derived from sessionID
   154→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   155→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   156→	}
   157→	if err != nil {
   158→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state: %w", err)
   159→	}
   160→
   161→	var state State
   162→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
   163→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal session state: %w", err)
   164→	}
   165→	return &state, nil
   166→}
   167→
   168→// Save saves the session state atomically.
   169→func (s *StateStore) Save(ctx context.Context, state *State) error {
   170→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   171→
   172→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   173→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(state.SessionID); err != nil {
   174→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   175→	}
   176→
   177→	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.stateDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   178→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session state directory: %w", err)
   179→	}
   180→
   181→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(state, "", "  ")
   182→	if err != nil {
   183→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session state: %w", err)
   184→	}
   185→
   186→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(state.SessionID)
   187→
   188→	// Atomic write: write to temp file, then rename
   189→	tmpFile := stateFile + ".tmp"
   190→	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpFile, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   191→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   192→	}
   193→	if err := os.Rename(tmpFile, stateFile); err != nil {
   194→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to rename session state file: %w", err)
   195→	}
   196→	return nil
   197→}
   198→
   199→// Clear removes the session state file for the given session ID.
   200→func (s *StateStore) Clear(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   201→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   202→
   203→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   204→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   205→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   206→	}
   207→
   208→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   209→
   210→	if err := os.Remove(stateFile); err != nil {
   211→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   212→			return nil // Already gone, not an error
   213→		}
   214→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state file: %w", err)
   215→	}
   216→	return nil
   217→}
   218→
   219→// RemoveAll removes the entire session state directory.
   220→// This is used during uninstall to completely remove all session state.
   221→func (s *StateStore) RemoveAll() error {
   222→	if err := os.RemoveAll(s.stateDir); err != nil {
   223→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state directory: %w", err)
   224→	}
   225→	return nil
   226→}
   227→
   228→// List returns all session states.
   229→func (s *StateStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]*State, error) {
   230→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   231→
   232→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.stateDir)
   233→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   234→		return nil, nil
   235→	}
   236→	if err != nil {
   237→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state directory: %w", err)
   238→	}
   239→
   240→	var states []*State
   241→	for _, entry := range entries {
   242→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   243→			continue
   244→		}
   245→		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".tmp") {
   246→			continue // Skip temp files
   247→		}
   248→
   249→		sessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")
   250→		state, err := s.Load(ctx, sessionID)
   251→		if err != nil {
   252→			continue // Skip corrupted state files
   253→		}
   254→		if state == nil {
   255→			continue
   256→		}
   257→
   258→		states = append(states, state)
   259→	}
   260→	return states, nil
   261→}
   262→
   263→// FindByBaseCommit finds all sessions based on the given commit hash.
   264→func (s *StateStore) FindByBaseCommit(ctx context.Context, baseCommit string) ([]*State, error) {
   265→	allStates, err := s.List(ctx)
   266→	if err != nil {
   267→		return nil, err
   268→	}
   269→
   270→	var matching []*State
   271→	for _, state := range allStates {
   272→		if state.BaseCommit == baseCommit {
   273→			matching = append(matching, state)
   274→		}
   275→	}
   276→	return matching, nil
   277→}
   278→
   279→// FindByWorktree finds all sessions for the given worktree path.
   280→func (s *StateStore) FindByWorktree(ctx context.Context, worktreePath string) ([]*State, error) {
   281→	allStates, err := s.List(ctx)
   282→	if err != nil {
   283→		return nil, err
   284→	}
   285→
   286→	var matching []*State
   287→	for _, state := range allStates {
   288→		if state.WorktreePath == worktreePath {
   289→			matching = append(matching, state)
   290→		}
   291→	}
   292→	return matching, nil
   293→}
   294→
   295→// stateFilePath returns the path to a session state file.
   296→func (s *StateStore) stateFilePath(sessionID string) string {
   297→	return filepath.Join(s.stateDir, sessionID+".json")
   298→}

   300→// getGitCommonDir returns the path to the shared git directory.
   301→// In a regular checkout, this is .git/
   302→// In a worktree, this is the main repo's .git/ (not .git/worktrees/<name>/)
   303→func getGitCommonDir() (string, error) {
   304→	ctx := context.Background()
   305→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
   306→	cmd.Dir = "."
   307→	output, err := cmd.Output()
   308→	if err != nil {
   309→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   310→	}
   311→
   312→	commonDir := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
   313→
   314→	// git rev-parse --git-common-dir returns relative paths from the working directory,
   315→	// so we need to make it absolute if it isn't already
   316→	if !filepath.IsAbs(commonDir) {
   317→		commonDir = filepath.Join(".", commonDir)
   318→	}
   319→
   320→	return filepath.Clean(commonDir), nil
   321→}
   322→
   323→// GetWorktreePath returns the absolute path to the current worktree root.
   324→func GetWorktreePath() (string, error) {
   325→	ctx := context.Background()
   326→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")
   327→	output, err := cmd.Output()
   328→	if err != nil {
   329→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree path: %w", err)
   330→	}
   331→	return strings.TrimSpace(string(output)), nil
   332→}

   334→// GetOrCreateEntireSessionID returns a stable session ID for the given agent session ID.
   335→// If a session state already exists with this ID, returns that session ID
   336→// (preserving the original date prefix). Otherwise creates a new ID with today's date.
   337→//
   338→// When multiple state files exist for the same ID (due to the midnight-crossing bug),
   339→// this function picks the most recent by date and cleans up older duplicates.
   340→//
   341→// This function never returns an error - it always falls back to generating a new ID
   342→// if any issues occur (e.g., corrupt git repo, permission problems, invalid ID).
   343→//
   344→// Note: This function is not thread-safe. Concurrent calls with the same ID may
   345→// race on file cleanup. In practice this is not an issue since agent hooks are
   346→// called sequentially within a session.
   347→func GetOrCreateEntireSessionID(agentSessionID string) string {
   348→	// Validate ID format to prevent path traversal attacks
   349→	if err := validation.ValidateAgentSessionID(agentSessionID); err != nil {
   350→		logging.Warn(context.Background(), "invalid agent session ID",
   351→			slog.String("input", agentSessionID),
   352→			slog.Any("error", err))
   353→		// Invalid ID - return it anyway (will fail downstream with clearer error)
   354→		// Don't generate random ID as that breaks session continuity
   355→		return sessionid.EntireSessionID(agentSessionID)
   356→	}
   357→
   358→	commonDir, err := getGitCommonDir()
   359→	if err != nil {
   360→		// Can't get common dir (corrupt git repo?) - fall back to new ID
   361→		return sessionid.EntireSessionID(agentSessionID)
   362→	}
   363→
   364→	stateDir := filepath.Join(commonDir, sessionStateDirName)
   365→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(stateDir)
   366→	if err != nil {
   367→		// State dir doesn't exist or can't read it - fall back to new ID
   368→		return sessionid.EntireSessionID(agentSessionID)
   369→	}
   370→
   371→	// Collect all matching session IDs
   372→	var matches []string
   373→	for _, entry := range entries {
   374→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   375→			continue
   376→		}
   377→
   378→		existingSessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")
   379→		existingUUID := sessionid.ModelSessionID(existingSessionID)
   380→
   381→		if existingUUID == agentSessionID {
   382→			matches = append(matches, existingSessionID)
   383→		}
   384→	}
   385→
   386→	if len(matches) == 0 {
   387→		// No existing session found - create new ID with today's date
   388→		return sessionid.EntireSessionID(agentSessionID)
   389→	}
   390→
   391→	// Pick most recent (YYYY-MM-DD sorts correctly lexicographically)
   392→	sort.Strings(matches)
   393→	mostRecent := matches[len(matches)-1]
   394→
   395→	// Best-effort cleanup of old duplicates (ignore errors)
   396→	for _, oldID := range matches[:len(matches)-1] {
   397→		oldFile := filepath.Join(stateDir, oldID+".json")
   398→		_ = os.Remove(oldFile)
   399→	}
   400→
   401→	return mostRecent
   402→}

    26→// currentSessionIDWithFallback returns the persisted Entire session ID when available.
    27→// Falls back to deriving from the model session ID for backward compatibility.
    28→func currentSessionIDWithFallback(modelSessionID string) string {
    29→	entireSessionID, err := paths.ReadCurrentSession()
    30→	if err != nil {
    31→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to read current session: %v\n", err)
    32→	}
    33→	if entireSessionID != "" {
    34→		// Validate persisted session ID to fail-fast on corrupted files
    35→		if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(entireSessionID); err != nil {
    36→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: invalid persisted session ID: %v\n", err)
    37→			// Fall through to fallback
    38→		} else if modelSessionID == "" || sessionid.ModelSessionID(entireSessionID) == modelSessionID {
    39→			return entireSessionID
    40→		} else {
    41→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: persisted session ID does not match hook session ID\n")
    42→		}
    43→	}
    44→	if modelSessionID == "" {
    45→		return ""
    46→	}
    47→	// Get or create stable session ID (reuses existing if session resumed across days)
    48→	return session.GetOrCreateEntireSessionID(modelSessionID)
    49→}

    59→// parseAndLogHookInput parses the hook input and sets up logging context.
    60→func parseAndLogHookInput() (*hookInputData, error) {
    61→	// Get the agent from the hook command context (e.g., "entire hooks claude-code ...")
    62→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
    63→	if err != nil {
    64→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
    65→	}
    66→
    67→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
    68→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookUserPromptSubmit, os.Stdin)
    69→	if err != nil {
    70→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
    71→	}
    72→
    73→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
    74→	logging.Info(logCtx, "user-prompt-submit",
    75→		slog.String("hook", "user-prompt-submit"),
    76→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
    77→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
    78→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),

    80→
    81→	modelSessionID := input.SessionID

    87→	entireSessionID := currentSessionIDWithFallback(modelSessionID)

    91→		input:           input,

    97→// checkConcurrentSessions checks for concurrent session conflicts and shows warnings if needed.
    98→// Returns true if the hook should be skipped due to an unresolved conflict.
    99→func checkConcurrentSessions(ag agent.Agent, entireSessionID string) (bool, error) {
   100→	// Check if warnings are disabled via settings
   101→	if IsMultiSessionWarningDisabled() {
   102→		return false, nil
   103→	}
   104→
   105→	strat := GetStrategy()
   106→
   107→	concurrentChecker, ok := strat.(strategy.ConcurrentSessionChecker)
   108→	if !ok {
   109→		return false, nil // Strategy doesn't support concurrent checks
   110→	}
   111→
   112→	// Check if this session already acknowledged the warning
   113→	existingState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(entireSessionID)
   114→	warningAlreadyShown := loadErr == nil && existingState != nil && existingState.ConcurrentWarningShown
   115→
   116→	// Check for other active sessions with checkpoints (on current HEAD)
   117→	otherSession, checkErr := concurrentChecker.HasOtherActiveSessionsWithCheckpoints(entireSessionID)
   118→	hasConflict := checkErr == nil && otherSession != nil
   119→
   120→	if warningAlreadyShown {
   121→		if hasConflict {
   122→			// Warning was shown and conflict still exists - skip hooks
   123→			return true, nil
   124→		}
   125→		// Warning was shown but conflict is resolved (e.g., user committed)
   126→		// Clear the flag and proceed normally
   127→		if existingState != nil {
   128→			existingState.ConcurrentWarningShown = false
   129→			if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(existingState); saveErr != nil {
   130→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to clear concurrent warning flag: %v\n", saveErr)
   131→			}
   132→		}
   133→		return false, nil
   134→	}
   135→
   136→	if hasConflict {
   137→		// First time seeing conflict - show warning
   138→		// Include BaseCommit and WorktreePath so session state is complete for condensation
   139→		repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository()
   140→		if err != nil {
   141→			// Output user-friendly error message via hook response
   142→			if outputErr := outputHookResponse(false, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to open git repository: %v\n\nPlease ensure you're in a git repository and try again.", err)); outputErr != nil {
   143→				return false, outputErr
   144→			}
   145→			return true, nil // Skip hook after outputting response
   146→		}
   147→		head, err := repo.Head()
   148→		if err != nil {
   149→			// Output user-friendly error message via hook response
   150→			if outputErr := outputHookResponse(false, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to get git HEAD: %v\n\nPlease ensure the repository has at least one commit.", err)); outputErr != nil {
   151→				return false, outputErr
   152→			}
   153→			return true, nil // Skip hook after outputting response
   154→		}
   155→		worktreePath, err := strategy.GetWorktreePath()
   156→		if err != nil {
   157→			// Non-fatal: continue without worktree path
   158→			worktreePath = ""
   159→		}
   160→		agentType := ag.Type()
   161→		newState := &strategy.SessionState{
   162→			SessionID:              entireSessionID,
   163→			BaseCommit:             head.Hash().String(),
   164→			WorktreePath:           worktreePath,
   165→			ConcurrentWarningShown: true,
   166→			StartedAt:              time.Now(),
   167→			AgentType:              agentType,
   168→		}
   169→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(newState); saveErr != nil {
   170→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save session state: %v\n", saveErr)
   171→		}
   172→
   173→		// Get resume command for the other session using the CONFLICTING session's agent type.
   174→		// If the conflicting session is from a different agent (e.g., Gemini when we're Claude),
   175→		// use that agent's resume command format. Otherwise, use our own format (backward compatible).
   176→		var resumeCmd string
   177→		if otherSession.AgentType != "" && otherSession.AgentType != agentType {
   178→			// Different agent type - look up the conflicting agent
   179→			if conflictingAgent, agentErr := agent.GetByAgentType(otherSession.AgentType); agentErr == nil {
   180→				resumeCmd = conflictingAgent.FormatResumeCommand(conflictingAgent.ExtractAgentSessionID(otherSession.SessionID))
   181→			}
   182→		}
   183→		// Fall back to current agent if same type or couldn't get the conflicting agent
   184→		if resumeCmd == "" {
   185→			resumeCmd = ag.FormatResumeCommand(ag.ExtractAgentSessionID(otherSession.SessionID))
   186→		}
   187→
   188→		// Try to read the other session's initial prompt
   189→		otherPrompt := strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromShadow(repo, otherSession.BaseCommit, otherSession.SessionID)
   190→
   191→		// Build message with other session's prompt if available
   192→		var message string
   193→		suppressHint := "\n\nTo suppress this warning in future sessions, run:\n  entire enable --disable-multisession-warning"
   194→		if otherPrompt != "" {
   195→			message = fmt.Sprintf("Another session is active: \"%s\"\n\nYou can continue here, but checkpoints from both sessions will be interleaved.\n\nTo resume the other session instead, exit Claude and run: %s%s\n\nPress the up arrow key to get your prompt back.", otherPrompt, resumeCmd, suppressHint)
   196→		} else {
   197→			message = "Another session is active with uncommitted changes. You can continue here, but checkpoints from both sessions will be interleaved.\n\nTo resume the other session instead, exit Claude and run: " + resumeCmd + suppressHint + "\n\nPress the up arrow key to get your prompt back."
   198→		}
   199→
   200→		// Output blocking JSON response - warn about concurrent sessions but allow continuation
   201→		// Both sessions will capture checkpoints, which will be interleaved on the shadow branch
   202→		if err := outputHookResponse(false, message); err != nil {
   203→			return false, err // Failed to output response
   204→		}
   205→		// Block the first prompt to show the warning, but subsequent prompts will proceed
   206→		return true, nil
   207→	}
   208→
   209→	return false, nil
   210→}
